CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. Which response best shows understanding of Physical? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Physical.
   B. Say Physical has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Physical with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Physical to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation.
   D. Use Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story: Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible Story: Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Bible Story: Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story: Holy Bible.
   D. Use Bible Story: Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible Story;? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Bible Story; has no place in daily life.
   C. Use The Bible Story; to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible Story;.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Creation of Plants and Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Use Creation of Plants and Animals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Creation of Plants and Animals.
   C. Say Creation of Plants and Animals has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Creation of Plants and Animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Use Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Christ.
   C. Say Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of My 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My 1.0 Creation.
   B. Apply the teaching of My 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use My 1.0 Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say My 1.0 Creation has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Healing of of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing of of Jesus Christ.
   B. Say Healing of of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Healing of of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Healing of of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

11. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Bible has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible.
   C. Use The Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Wedding? (1 mark)
   A. Use Wedding to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wedding.
   C. Say Wedding has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Wedding with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Wedding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Healing of of Jesus Christ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Sharing values and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Obedience values and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
